full.description: This is a micrograph of a kidney tissue sample showing a glomerulus. The image highlights a characteristic Kimmelstiel-Wilson lesion, which is an ovoid, nodular, hyaline deposit within the glomerular mesangium. The surrounding interstitium and tubules are also visible in the field. These findings are most consistent with diabetic glomerulosclerosis.

claims.text: A Kimmelstiel‑Wilson lesion (ovoid nodular hyaline deposit) is present in the mesangium.
claims.label: supported

blind.description: This image is a micrograph of a kidney tissue sample. The histologic section shows structural alterations characteristic of diabetic nephropathy, specifically Kimmelstiel-Wilson lesions. These findings are marked by nodular glomerulosclerosis within the renal glomeruli. The most likely diagnosis is Kimmelstiel-Wilson disease affecting the kidney.

claims.text: The diagnosis is Kimmelstiel‑Wilson disease (diabetic nephropathy).
claims.label: silent

random.description: This is a photomicrograph of a renal glomerulus. The tissue section shows hyaline changes and deposition of amorphous eosinophilic material within the capillary loops of the glomerulus. These features are characteristic of diabetic glomerulosclerosis or nodular glomerulosclerosis, often associated with diabetic nephropathy. Surrounding tubular structures and interstitial tissue are also visible in the kidney cortex.
